name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Double Agent
description: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Double Agent is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person stealth action game and the fourth in the Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell series.
notes: Double Agent installs single-player and multiplayer as two separate builds — the multiplayer build (SCDA-Online) no longer works, so set up the single-player build in SCDA-Offline.
